question: 老人一共有多少人
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM person_info WHERE deleted = 0

question: 性别分布
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN is_gender = 1 THEN '男' WHEN is_gender = 2 THEN '女' ELSE '未知' END AS gender, COUNT(*) AS count FROM person_info WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY gender ORDER BY count DESC

question: 有健康档案的老人有多少
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT phr.person_id) AS count FROM person_health_records phr INNER JOIN person_info p ON p.id = phr.person_id WHERE phr.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted = 0

question: 列出老人姓名和年龄
sql: SELECT name, age, CASE WHEN is_gender = 1 THEN '男' WHEN is_gender = 2 THEN '女' ELSE '未知' END AS gender FROM person_info WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 50

question: 陈明宇最近一周做过足压吗
sql: SELECT person_name, create_time FROM remote_activity_foot_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND person_name = '陈明宇' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 20

question: 龙奶奶的健康指标有哪些
sql: SELECT p.name, phr.* FROM person_info p INNER JOIN person_health_records phr ON phr.person_id = p.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND phr.deleted = 0 AND p.name = '龙奶奶' LIMIT 50
